in_sanskrit.name: तेज्वीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings progress with his power.

in_marathi.name: Tejveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tejveer is a name of Sanskrit origin which means 'Brave, Victorious'. This name is derived from two words - 'Tej' meaning 'Might, Power, Radiance, Strength, Virtue, Victory' and 'Veer' meaning 'Hero, Brave'. The name Tejveer signifies a person who is powerful, strong, and courageous.
